sections.markdown:
**ITT & Latitudes Travel**

ITT provides discount tickets to tourist attractions and special events. Purchase tickets to local and national attractions including theme parks, dinner shows, harbor cruises, one-day island tours, skiing, whale-watching, sporting events, and so much more! To view current prices, just click the ITT price list button.

Latitudes Travel is a full-service agency dedicated to ensuring every trip is a memorable one. Advisors are committed to providing the best service and value for all your travel needs. Enjoy the finest in vacation packages, cruises, and other travel-related services such as excursions, airfare, car rental, and hotel reservations.

Let Latitudes Travel take the stress out of planning your next vacation!

**MCRD San Diego Recruit Travel for Family and Friends**

Congratulations on your family member joining the United States Marine Corps!

Latitudes Travel at Camp Pendleton is the travel agency providing airline, car, and hotel reservations for Marine Recruit Families attending MCRD San Diego graduation. With one call you can arrange and consolidate all your travel with Latitudes Travel while receiving great service at a great value!

Once you are ready to make your reservations contact our team at 3184 for assistance. We are dedicated to finding the best quality and value while arranging your travel to San Diego. Our office is open and available to take your call Mon-Fri: 8:30 am - 5 pm.

**American Forces Travel**

An MWR joint service initiative has resulted in the first official DoD online vacation travel site, American Forces Travel℠, with Priceline Partner Network® as the service provider. The site offers travel deals and benefits exclusively for military members and authorized patrons! American Forces Travel℠ provides access to a wide selection of discounted rates on hotels, airfare, rental cars, vacation packages, cruises, and much more! Log onto www.americanforcestravel.com and plan your dream vacation!
